sources.title: Alpaca Docs — Getting Started
sources.relevant_claim: Alpaca offers Trading API, Market Data API, Broker API, paper trading and OAuth Connect.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Owner geographic eligibility and product entitlements require owner confirmation.

sources.title: Alpaca Trading API Getting Started
sources.relevant_claim: Trading API supports account, positions, orders, portfolio history for individuals/business accounts.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Exact paper vs live key separation and IP allow-list UI path needs owner console verification.

sources.title: Alpaca Paper Trading environment (paper-api.alpaca.markets)
sources.relevant_claim: Paper trading environment available separate from live; keys target paper-api host.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Current paper host and key isolation documented in dashboard; verify at canary time.

sources.title: Binance API Terms / product page
sources.relevant_claim: Official API product exists with documentation and sample code; API keys created via account.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Entity (global vs regional) and residency restrictions are jurisdiction-specific and unresolved for owner.

sources.title: Binance Developer Docs — Account/Wallet REST
sources.relevant_claim: Authenticated account endpoints require API key; restriction model includes trading/withdrawal separation.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Geographic product availability and KYC requirements owner-specific.

sources.title: Bybit API documentation
sources.relevant_claim: Bybit V5 API covers account, positions, order history with API key permissions.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Regional restrictions and derivatives focus may misalign with initial equity-first roadmap.

sources.title: Coinbase Advanced Trade API product page
sources.relevant_claim: CDP API keys support permission configuration; IP whitelist encouraged; keys may not expire by default.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Default non-expiring keys increase residual risk; owner must force rotation policy.

sources.title: Get API Key Permissions (Advanced Trade)
sources.relevant_claim: can_view / can_trade / can_transfer permission flags enable read/write/transfer separation.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Portfolio UUID binding and multi-portfolio isolation require owner confirmation.

sources.title: Coinbase Business OAuth2 Scopes
sources.relevant_claim: Fine-grained OAuth scopes exist; canary planning prefers non-OAuth API key path if available.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: OAuth is forbidden for M240-M247 runtime; future use needs separate security review.

sources.title: Interactive Brokers Client Portal / Web API documentation hub
sources.relevant_claim: IBKR provides Client Portal Web API and TWS/Gateway APIs; authentication model is session/OAuth oriented.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Complexity of gateway/session model elevates operational risk for a first canary.

sources.title: Kraken API key permissions guide
sources.relevant_claim: Granular permissions: Query Funds; Query Open/Closed Orders & Trades; separate withdraw and trade permissions.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: IP allow-list and key expiry options need console verification by owner.

sources.title: Kraken Get API Key Info
sources.relevant_claim: GetApiKeyInfo returns key permissions including query-funds and withdraw-funds for introspection.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Whether all future permission strings are stable across API versions.

sources.title: Kite Connect API documentation
sources.relevant_claim: Kite Connect supports account, holdings, positions, orders for Indian markets; login token model.
sources.unresolved_ambiguity: Primarily India-resident product; owner residency eligibility unconfirmed.

note: Documentation research is separate from runtime provider transport.
